children: will divest its stake in Alexander Forbes Group Holdings, South Africa's largest stand-alone retirement fund administrator, as a firm associated with billionaire Patrice Motsepe consolidates its control of the company, Alexander Forbes Group said Friday.
ARC AF Holdings, which is affiliated with Motsepe's African Rainbow Capital, plans to boost its stake in Alexander Forbes to 77.94% from its current 49.88% interest, the company said in a statement.
New Veld LLC, a firm that's 99% owned by Prudential

, holds 34.39% of Alexander Forbes. Alexander Forbes will buy back 372.8M shares from New Veld for ~2.5B rand (US$150M). In addition, Motsepe's ARC will buy New Veld's remaining 74.1M Alexander Forbes shares directly.
Alexander Forbes will pay for the buyback with cash on hand and a 2.1B-rand loan, the statement said.

title: Prudential Financial exits holdings in South Africa's Alexander Forbes
